description: Red Flag Engine rules. Conditions use the documented rule expression syntax and are evaluated against normalized transaction facts. Rules are configurable: edit this file and restart the app.

rules.name: Unknown Ultimate End User
rules.explanation: The ultimate end user was not identified. Verify the end user before proceeding and determine whether enhanced due diligence is appropriate.

rules.name: Unknown Ultimate Destination
rules.explanation: The ultimate destination was not identified. Destination determines which EAR provisions and embargo programs may be implicated.

rules.name: Destination Under Comprehensive U.S. Embargo
rules.explanation: The ultimate destination is a country subject to a comprehensive U.S. embargo program. Transactions to this destination require legal review; this tool does not determine authorization.

rules.name: Military or Defense-Related Indicators
rules.explanation: Military- or defense-related terms appear in the product description or declared end use. Additional classification and end-use scrutiny is warranted.

rules.name: Possible Restricted Party Name Match
rules.explanation: A screened party name matches or closely matches an entry in the loaded reference list. Manual verification of the party's identity and status is required. A name match alone never establishes that a party is restricted.

rules.name: Fuzzy Name Similarity Below Verification Threshold
rules.explanation: A screened party name is similar to an entry in the reference list. Confirm spelling, legal entity, and ownership details before relying on the screening result.

rules.name: De Minimis Ratio Near or Above Review Threshold
rules.explanation: The calculated ratio of U.S.-origin controlled content to total foreign-product value is 5% or higher. The applicable threshold is a legal determination and requires review of current EAR text and ECCN-specific rules.

rules.name: Foreign Production Dependency on U.S. Items
rules.explanation: The foreign-produced item may be produced with U.S.-origin software or technology. Foreign Direct Product rule applicability requires careful legal review.

rules.name: Jurisdiction Review Flagged or Incomplete
rules.explanation: EAR jurisdiction could not be preliminarily assessed from the recorded facts or a formal jurisdiction review was flagged. Do not proceed on the assumption that jurisdiction is resolved.

rules.name: De Minimis Calculation Incomplete
rules.explanation: The item is foreign-produced with recorded U.S.-origin content, but the de minimis ratio could not be calculated. Collect the value of the controlled U.S.-origin content and the total value of the foreign-produced item before closing the review.

rules.name: Encryption Capability Without a Recorded Classification
rules.explanation: The product description refers to encryption or cryptography but no ECCN is recorded. Encryption items are frequently controlled, for example under ECCN 5A002 or 5D002, so the classification should be confirmed.

rules.name: Buyer Located in a Comprehensively Embargoed Country
rules.explanation: The buyer is located in a country subject to a comprehensive U.S. embargo program. Review the transaction even when the recorded ultimate destination is elsewhere, because of diversion risk.
